title: Compiled procedure
description: One prose command compiled into a graph of typed steps. Step order in the file is execution order: a step may only consume values produced above it.

source.description: Path of the prose file this was compiled from, relative to the sources folder passed to the validator.

notes.description: Ambiguities and inconsistencies the compile had to surface. Findings about the prose, not opinions about the design.

kind.description: script: a fixed command or file operation. judgment: the model decides. gate: an automated check that can stop the run. approval: a human must answer. report: output handed to the human.

effect.description: read: reads only. local: writes on this machine. spend: an outside call that costs money or quota. remote: changes something outside this machine (push, PR, merge, issue, publish).

conditional.description: True when the prose says the step only happens in some runs.

destructive.description: True when the step deletes something.

uses.description: Id of a shared sub-procedure in subprocedures.yaml.

after.description: Order-only dependencies, for steps that must wait on another without consuming its output.

quote.description: Verbatim text from one line of the source. The validator rejects the step if the source no longer contains it.
